q: How much carbon does an LED billboard emit?
title: LED billboard: emissions
short: An LED billboard's emissions are its electricity, often running 16 to 24 hours a day. Multiply metered kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. The media owner pays the bill and reports it as Scope 2. An advertiser can count its share as Scope 3 purchased services.

p: Panel power rating times hours on times average brightness, labelled as an estimate until a meter is fitted.
Dimming at night and switching off between midnight and dawn cuts power sharply.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
